intro: CAVA Black Lentils are a protein-packed base option that brings earthy flavor and hearty texture to your customized bowl or pita. Made from premium black beluga lentils seasoned with olive oil and spices, this nutritious base delivers 18g of protein and 270 calories per serving. Explore the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) to discover why Black Lentils are a customer favorite for building satisfying Mediterranean meals.
priceCalories: Black Lentils are included at no additional charge as part of your CAVA bowl or pita base selection. At 270 calories per serving, they provide substantial nutrition with 18g protein, 37g carbs, and 7g fat. This makes them an excellent value choice when building your meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). The included pricing allows you to create filling, protein-rich bowls without extra cost.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Black Lentils apart is their unique black beluga variety, prized for their firm texture and rich, earthy flavor. Unlike regular lentils that turn mushy, these maintain their shape beautifully in bowls. Seasoned with olive oil and Mediterranean spices, they offer authentic flavor that complements the diverse options across the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) perfectly.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Black Lentils contains 270 calories with an impressive macronutrient profile: 18g protein, 37g carbohydrates, and 7g fat. This balanced nutrition makes them ideal for those tracking macros or seeking plant-based protein sources. The high protein content rivals many meat options while providing fiber and complex carbs. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how Black Lentils fit your dietary goals.
whatsInside: CAVA Black Lentils feature premium black beluga lentils as the star ingredient, combined with heart-healthy olive oil and a proprietary blend of Mediterranean spices. These tiny, caviar-like lentils are naturally rich in fiber, iron, and plant-based protein. The simple ingredient list ensures clean eating while the olive oil adds healthy fats and helps the spices coat each lentil for maximum flavor throughout your bowl.
tasteLike: Black Lentils offer a distinctly earthy, slightly nutty flavor with savory depth from the olive oil and spice blend. Their texture is firm yet tender, providing satisfying substance without being heavy or mushy. The Mediterranean seasoning adds subtle warmth and complexity that enhances without overpowering other ingredients. They deliver a more robust, hearty taste compared to rice bases while maintaining versatility for various flavor combinations.
customize: Build your perfect bowl starting with Black Lentils from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), then customize with proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Grilled Chicken or Falafel. Add complementary options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) such as Roasted Red Pepper Hummus. Layer with fresh vegetables and finish with [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) selections like Lemon Herb Tahini for a personalized Mediterranean experience.
pairsWell: Black Lentils pair exceptionally well with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. Try them with spicy harissa, cooling Tzatziki, or creamy hummus varieties. They complement grilled proteins like chicken or lamb meatballs beautifully. Fresh toppings like tomato-cucumber salad, pickled onions, and feta cheese add brightness that balances the lentils earthiness. Lemon-based dressings enhance their natural nutty flavor while adding refreshing acidity to each bite.
healthyChoice: Black Lentils are an outstanding healthy choice, delivering 18g of plant-based protein and substantial fiber for digestive health. They provide complex carbohydrates for sustained energy without blood sugar spikes. Rich in iron, folate, and antioxidants, these lentils support overall wellness while keeping calories moderate at 270 per serving. The olive oil adds heart-healthy monounsaturated fats, making this base ideal for balanced, nutritious Mediterranean eating.
howToOrder: Order Black Lentils by selecting them as your base when building a custom bowl or pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). Simply tell the team member you would like Black Lentils, or if ordering online or via app, choose them from the bases section. They are included in your meal price. You can also request them in [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) items by asking for a base substitution.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Brown Rice (310 cal) and Saffron Basmati Rice (290 cal), Black Lentils offer more protein (18g vs 6-7g) at similar or fewer calories. Unlike Super Greens (35 cal) or Power Greens (30 cal), they provide substantial carbs and protein for a complete base. Black Lentils offer the best protein-to-calorie ratio among hearty bases while delivering more fiber than rice options, making them ideal for balanced nutrition seekers.
whoShouldTry: Black Lentils are perfect for vegetarians and vegans seeking substantial plant-based protein, fitness enthusiasts tracking macros, and anyone wanting a nutrient-dense base. They suit those following Mediterranean diets, looking for gluten-free options, or preferring heartier alternatives to greens. If you enjoy earthy flavors and satisfying textures, or want a filling base that supports wellness goals without extra cost, Black Lentils deserve a try on your next CAVA visit.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying! CAVA Black Lentils deliver exceptional nutritional value with 18g protein at no additional cost, making them one of the smartest base choices available. Their unique texture and earthy flavor profile create a satisfying foundation that elevates any bowl combination. Whether you are seeking plant-based protein, exploring healthier fast-casual options, or simply want something different from standard rice or greens, Black Lentils offer delicious versatility that keeps customers coming back.

faqs.a: Yes, Black Lentils are naturally gluten-free, making them a safe base option for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for more compatible options.

faqs.q: How much protein is in CAVA Black Lentils?
faqs.a: CAVA Black Lentils contain 18g of protein per serving, making them the highest protein base option available. This plant-based protein content rivals many animal-based proteins on the menu.

faqs.q: Do Black Lentils cost extra at CAVA?
faqs.a: No, Black Lentils are included in your base selection at no additional charge. They are priced the same as other standard bases like rice or greens when building your bowl or pita.

faqs.q: What do CAVA Black Lentils taste like?
faqs.a: Black Lentils have an earthy, slightly nutty flavor with savory notes from olive oil and Mediterranean spices. Their firm texture holds up well in bowls, providing satisfying substance without being mushy or heavy.

faqs.q: Are Black Lentils vegan at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Black Lentils are completely vegan, made only from black beluga lentils, olive oil, and plant-based spices. They provide excellent plant-based protein for vegan and vegetarian diets.
